_comment: Phase 1 EIKON seed catalog. PRICES ARE PLACEHOLDERS the operator must set before any public launch (docs/shop/PHASE1.md). Imagery is representative, rights-verified public-domain artwork fetched by scripts/fetch-shop-media.mjs; image_is_representative stays true until real supplier product photos exist. Classifications use only the honest vocabulary; nothing here claims hand-painted or original work.

products.title: Christ Pantocrator
products.subtitle: The Sinai Pantocrator, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: The oldest surviving icon of Christ Pantocrator, kept at St Catherine's Monastery on Sinai since the sixth century. The two sides of the face, often read as His mercy and His judgment, have met every generation of the Church since. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board, ready for the prayer corner or the desk.

media.alt: The Sinai icon of Christ Pantocrator: Christ blessing with His right hand and holding the Gospels, sixth century encaustic
media.query: Christ Pantocrator Sinai icon sixth century encaustic

products.title: Theotokos of Vladimir
products.subtitle: The Vladimirskaya, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: The Vladimir Mother of God, painted in Constantinople around 1131 and beloved across the Orthodox world: the Child pressing His cheek to His Mother's, her eyes toward the one who prays. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: The Vladimir icon of the Theotokos: the Christ Child pressing His cheek against His Mother's, twelfth-century Byzantine icon

products.title: St Nicholas the Wonderworker
products.subtitle: Wooden icon of the bishop of Myra
products.description: Nicholas of Myra, the friend of sailors, prisoners, and children, shown vested as a bishop with the Gospels. After the ancient icon at Sinai. Printed and sealed on a solid wooden plank with a raised border, in the manner of a traditional panel icon.
products.materials: Lime wood, sealed print, matte varnish

media.alt: Icon of St Nicholas the Wonderworker vested as a bishop, blessing with his right hand and holding the Gospels
media.query: Saint Nicholas Sinai 13th century icon bust

products.title: The Archangel Michael
products.subtitle: Standard reproduction of the Byzantine archangel
products.description: The Captain of the Bodiless Hosts, after the fourteenth-century Byzantine tradition. A faithful reproduction print on heavy archival paper, unmounted, ready for framing.

media.alt: Byzantine icon of the Archangel Michael holding a staff, gold ground

products.title: St Seraphim of Sarov
products.subtitle: Printed and mounted icon of the Sarov elder
products.description: Seraphim of Sarov, who greeted every visitor with 'My joy, Christ is risen.' After a nineteenth-century depiction of the saint. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: Icon of St Seraphim of Sarov in a white cassock, his hand raised in blessing
preferred: File:Saint Serafim Of Sarov Portrait Painted During His Life.jpg

products.title: St Sergius of Radonezh
products.subtitle: Printed and mounted icon of the abbot of Russia
products.description: Sergius of Radonezh, whose forest hermitage became the Trinity Lavra and whose blessing sent a nation to Kulikovo. After the medieval Moscow tradition. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: Icon of St Sergius of Radonezh in monastic habit, blessing
media.query: Sergius of Radonezh icon medieval embroidery shroud

products.title: The Apostle Peter
products.subtitle: Laminated pocket icon
products.description: The first-called of the Twelve to confess Christ as the Son of the living God, shown from the fourteenth-century Vysotsky Deesis range. A small laminated icon for the wallet, the car, or the bedside, sealed against wear.

media.alt: The Apostle Peter turned in prayer, from the fourteenth-century Vysotsky Deesis range
preferred: File:Peter from Vysotsky chin (14c, Tretyakov gallery).jpg

products.title: The Anastasis
products.subtitle: The icon of Pascha, printed and mounted
products.description: Christ trampling the gates of Hades and raising Adam and Eve by the wrist: the Church's icon of the Resurrection. After the classic Byzantine composition. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: The Anastasis: Christ standing on the broken gates of Hades, raising Adam and Eve

products.title: Prayer Corner Starter Set
products.subtitle: Three mounted icons for the home icon corner
products.description: Three printed and mounted icons to begin a family prayer corner: Christ Pantocrator, the Theotokos of Vladimir, and the Holy Trinity after Rublev. Each printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: The Holy Trinity after Andrei Rublev: three angels seated around the table of Abraham's hospitality
media.query: Rublev Trinity icon Angels at Mamre

products.title: Deesis Diptych
products.subtitle: Hinged wooden diptych of Christ and the Theotokos
products.description: A hinged two-panel wooden icon that stands open on a desk or folds shut for travel: Christ enthroned on the right panel, His Mother in intercession on the left, after the Deesis tradition. Printed, sealed, and varnished on jointed wooden panels.
products.materials: Lime wood, brass hinges, sealed print

media.alt: Deesis icon: the Theotokos turned in intercession toward Christ
preferred: File:Christ Pantocrator from Vysotsky chin (14c, Tretyakov gallery).jpg

products.title: The Holy Trinity
products.subtitle: Rublev's Trinity, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: Andrei Rublev's icon of the Hospitality of Abraham, painted for the Trinity Lavra of St Sergius in the early fifteenth century: three angels at one table, the whole Godhead read in the inclination of three heads toward a single cup. After the Moscow tradition. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: Andrei Rublev's icon of the Holy Trinity: three angels seated around the table of Abraham's hospitality, one chalice between them
media.query: Rublev Trinity icon Angels at Mamre

products.title: Theotokos of Kazan
products.subtitle: The Kazanskaya, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: The Mother of God of Kazan, whose image was found in the ashes of a burned city in 1579 and carried afterward through Russia's darkest hours: the Child standing at her side, her head inclined toward Him. After the Kazan type. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: The Kazan icon of the Mother of God: the Christ Child standing at her side, her head inclined toward Him
media.query: Our Lady of Kazan icon Theotokos

products.title: St George the Trophy-bearer
products.subtitle: The dragon-slayer of Cappadocia, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: George of Cappadocia, soldier and martyr under Diocletian, shown in the miracle the Church never tired of telling: the rider on the white horse, the spear, the dragon underfoot. After the medieval Novgorod tradition. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: St George on a white horse, his red cloak flying, driving his spear into the dragon beneath the hooves
media.query: Saint George dragon icon Novgorod Tretyakov
preferred: File:Saint George icon. Novgorod icon-painting school, 15th cent.., Veliky Novgorod, Russia. Tretyakov Gallery.jpg

products.title: St John the Forerunner
products.subtitle: The Baptist of the Lord, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: John the Forerunner, greatest born of women, who pointed away from himself to the Lamb of God. After the Deesis mosaic of Hagia Sophia. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: St John the Forerunner from the Deesis mosaic of Hagia Sophia, his head bowed in intercession
media.query: John the Forerunner Deesis mosaic Hagia Sophia

products.title: The Nativity of Christ
products.subtitle: The feast of the Incarnation, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: The Nativity in the cave: the Mother of God reclining beside the manger, the Child warmed by the breath of the ox and the ass, the shepherds and the magi drawn to one star. After the Byzantine tradition. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: The Nativity of Christ: the Mother of God reclining beside the manger, the Child in the cave
preferred: File:Byzantine School - The Nativity - RCIN 403381 - Royal Collection.jpg

products.title: The Theophany
products.subtitle: The Baptism of the Lord in Jordan, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: Christ standing in the Jordan under the hand of the Forerunner, the Spirit descending as a dove, the voice of the Father over the water: the feast on which the Holy Trinity was made manifest. After the mosaic of the baptistery at Ravenna. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: The Baptism of Christ in the Jordan: the Forerunner's hand on His head and the dove of the Spirit descending
media.query: Baptism of Christ Theophany mosaic Ravenna

products.title: The Dormition of the Theotokos
products.subtitle: The falling-asleep of the Mother of God, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: The Mother of God asleep on the bier, the apostles gathered from the ends of the earth, and Christ standing behind her to receive her soul as a little child in swaddling clothes. After Theophanes the Greek. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: The Dormition of the Theotokos: the apostles about her bier and Christ holding her soul as a swaddled child

products.title: The Guardian Angel
products.subtitle: The Angel of the Golden Hair, printed and mounted on wood
products.description: The face known as the Angel of the Golden Hair, an archangel from twelfth-century Novgorod kept now in the Russian Museum: the great eyes turned inward, the stillness of one who stands before God. Printed on archival stock and mounted on a wooden board.

media.alt: The Angel of the Golden Hair, a twelfth-century archangel with great inward-turned eyes
media.query: Angel Golden Hair archangel icon Novgorod
